mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (user_id, image_url, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{imageUrl}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_like WHERE photo_id = p.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS likedByCurrentUser FROM photo p JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_like WHERE photo_id = p.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS likedByCurrentUser FROM photo p JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.upload_time DESC

SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_like WHERE photo_id = p.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS likedByCurrentUser FROM photo p JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY p.upload_time DESC

SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo_like WHERE photo_id = p.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) > 0 AS likedByCurrentUser FROM photo p JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE DATE(p.upload_time) = #{date} ORDER BY p.upload_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE photo SET like_count = like_count + #{increment} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE photo SET comment_count = comment_count + #{increment} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM photo WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
